text:
sam: quick idea  build a microcard for the benchmark launch that doubles as OG image + webinar cover + in-email header. single visual, tight copy.

ida: nice. what's the visual layout?

sam: three micro-panels in one row: tiny latency spark (median + p95), center compact scatter (latency vs $/1k) with 2 shaded lanes (hosted, dedicated), right = stacked %-savings waterfall (batching, quant, cache). minimal text.

cole: +1. want a tiny callout for <128 token burst path so chat teams see it instantly.

nora: data to use from last run: median=47ms/token, p95=160ms/token, baseline=$0.32/1k, optimized=$0.07/1k. i'll drop CSV to /marketing/bench/latest_bench_5219999999.csv by EOD.

sam: prefer percent labels in visual, but include a single-line $ baseline table in blog body. keeps hero clean.

ida: can we add a micro-legend explaining "fastpath" vs "throughput"? one-line only.

cole: yes. design note  no gridlines, two-tone palette, ensure OG contrast. add dashed baseline for hosted defaults.

ops-bot: Reminder: OG image min size 1200x630 px. Keep overlay text <=60 chars. Include alt text.

sdr_ops: routing: use UTM bench_microcard_q2_26. demo CTAs -> SDR queue B; enterprise interest flagged -> AE follow-up with tag "bench-enterprise". we'll add hidden field `bench_cohort=microcard` to forms.

nora: also add a short footer: "Tests run with open model Z on standard GPU; results vary by workload." keeps transparency.

ida: i'll mock two figma variants: 1) % deltas in hero 2) $ amounts in hero. link will be posted.

sam: copy variants for social: A) "Predictable inference: speed where you need it, savings where you don't." B) "Benchmark: lower unit costs, reliable latency." A feels friendlier.

cole: A wins. short and punchy.

ida: timeline: figma by tomorrow 10am, csv (nora) by EOD, hero copy (sam) by noon, blog target next Thu. sdr_ops to deliver routing rules by EOD.

nora: uploaded csv and README with run config. file path: /marketing/bench/latest_bench_5219999999.csv.

ops-bot: Note: schedule webhook to notify #sdr-ops when blog publishes.

sdr_ops: will set automation: demo signups -> SDR queue B within 5 mins; enterprise tags -> AE queue with priority flag.

sam: cool. once figma is up i'll pick OG final and lock copy. thanks all :rocket:
